# A2v10 Platform

> A2v10 is a full-stack platform for building business applications on SQL Server, ASP.NET Core, and Vue.js.
> Developers describe data (SQL), model (model.json), and UI (XAML) — the platform builds the application.

- [SQL](https://docs-llm.a2v10.com/sql.md): Naming, markers, stored procedures, the TVP+MERGE save pattern, tree and grouping models
- [XAML (UI Markup)](https://docs-llm.a2v10.com/xaml.md): Server-compiled Vue.js views — Page/Dialog roots, binding, controls, layouts, text elements
- [Model Configuration](https://docs-llm.a2v10.com/model.md): model.json — actions, dialogs, popups, commands, reports, file upload
- [Client Template](https://docs-llm.a2v10.com/template.md): Client-side JavaScript that defines model behavior — defaults, computed properties, validators, events, commands, delegates
- [Client API](https://docs-llm.a2v10.com/client.md): The client object model — `$`-prefixed members on objects, arrays, and trees, the controller, and std:utils
- [Application Configuration](https://docs-llm.a2v10.com/app.md): Application-wide files — menu.json navigation, special folders
